subLocations.name: the great drunkard
subLocations.lore:

subLocations.name: gralkyn's tavern
subLocations.lore:
History
During the Spellplague of 1385 DR, the walking statue appeared and rampaged through the city. When stopped, the statue tumbled backwards onto a building.

Gralkyn's Tavern sat in the statue's lap by 1492 

Description
The pose resembled that of a drunkard who had fallen asleep, its arms limp to the sides and its head tilted on its chest. The statue originally carried a large stone battleaxe, which was located nearby in the cobbles where it fell.

subLocations.name: Endshift Tavern
subLocations.lore: The Endshift Tavern was a frequent stop for off-duty members of the [[City Guard (Waterdeep)|City Guard]].

subLocations.name: The Ship's Wheel
subLocations.lore: The Ship's Wheel had a reputation for being one of the safest taverns around. Most activity within the tavern never got more exciting than the old patrons watching each others hair fall out.

subLocations.name: The Pilgrim's Rest
subLocations.lore: This comfortable inn was moderately priced, at least by Waterdeep standards. Many of the patrons stayed here while visiting Waterdeep's temples. A private room could be had for 9 gp per night and included stabling and a meal.

subLocations.name: The Wandering Wemic
subLocations.lore: Rooms could be had at the Wandering Wemic at a rate of 10 gp per night and included stabling, a valet service used for cleaning or repairing gear, and one bottle of wine per person per evening.

subLocations.name: Fiery Flagon
subLocations.lore: The Fiery Flagon was a stately old tavern that served excellent food.

subLocations.name: The Sleeping Snake
subLocations.lore: Rowdy tavern for dockhands and dancers, owner by [[Alard Belaerl]].

subLocations.name: Shipmasters' Hall
subLocations.lore: Shipmasters' Hall was an inn.

subLocations.name: Selûne's Smile
subLocations.lore: Selûne's Smile, also known as the Inn of the Crescent Moon, was a tavern and inn devoted to [[Selûne]]. Uniquely, it was established and run by an [[avatar]] of the goddess Selûne.

subLocations.name: The Red Gauntlet
subLocations.lore: Food served here consisted mostly of dried fish, waybread, and rabbit-and-fowl stew. Drink consisted of a house wine. The fares were cheap in the Red Gauntlet with a plate of food running just 3 cp and a tankard 2 cp.

subLocations.name: Copper Cup
subLocations.lore: The Copper Cup was a [[festhall]].

subLocations.name: Yawning Portal
subLocations.lore: The Yawning Portal inn gained most of its renown for being the primary open route to the [[Undermountain]].

subLocations.name: Bowels of the Earth
subLocations.lore: The tavern was a well-known spot for hiring [[mercenaries]].

subLocations.name: Rearing Hippocampus
subLocations.lore: The Rearing Hippocampus was an inn.

subLocations.name: The Blackstar Inn
subLocations.lore: The Blackstar Inn was owned by [[Asiyra Boldwinter]] during the mid-to-late 14th century DR. Armed guards protected the entryway and the stables.

subLocations.name: Gray Serpent
subLocations.lore: The Gray Serpent, which was also seen as the Grey Serpent, was an inn located in Waterdeep during the mid-to-late 14th century DR.

subLocations.name: Swords' Rest
subLocations.lore: Swords' Rest was a tavern and a good place to hire [[mercenaries]].

subLocations.name: Felzoun's Folly
subLocations.lore: This tavern was frequently quite crowded and noisy, but overall was a casual place where merchants and consumers alike stopped for a quick bite or drink.

subLocations.name: Ship's Prow
subLocations.lore: The inn's name derived from the fact that it was converted into a building from the prow of a ship.

subLocations.name: The Mermaid's Arms
subLocations.lore: The Mermaid's Arms was a pricey and busy tavern, inn, and festhall.

subLocations.name: Blue Mermaid
subLocations.lore: The tavern was well appointed and clean, if a bit tired.

subLocations.name: Hanging Lantern
subLocations.lore: The Hanging Lantern was a [[festhall]]. The building stood an impressive six storys tall.

subLocations.name: Sleeping Wench
subLocations.lore: This tavern could be rather rowdy, but less so compared to the [[Sleeping Snake]] and had a comparably better clientele.

subLocations.name: Thirsty Sailor
subLocations.lore: The Thirsty Sailor was an infamous dive bar.

subLocations.name: Warm Beds
subLocations.lore: Warm Beds was an [[inn]].

subLocations.name: Bloody Fist
subLocations.lore: The Bloody Fist was a [[tavern]].

subLocations.name: Hanged Man
subLocations.lore: This tavern offered a fine selection of [[wine]]s, far better than one might suspect it to have, as well as a wide variety of [[ale]]s.

subLocations.name: Three Pearls Nightclub
subLocations.lore: The Three Pearls Nightclub was a [[festhall]] and nightclub.

subLocations.name: Purple Palace
subLocations.lore: The Purple Palace was a [[festhall]].

subLocations.name: Thirsty Throat
subLocations.lore: The Thirsty Throat was a [[tavern]].

subLocations.name: Blushing Mermaid
subLocations.lore: The Blushing Mermaid was a tavern, inn, and festhall managed by Lady [[Alathene Moonstar]] circa the Year of Wild Magic, [[1372 DR]].

subLocations.name: Jade Dancer
subLocations.lore: The Jade Dancer was a [[festhall]] and [[tavern]].

subLocations.name: The Full Cup
subLocations.lore: The Full Cup's patrons were mostly caravan drovers. Brawls were a common occurrence in this seedy [[tavern]].

subLocations.name: Pampered Traveler
subLocations.lore: Pampered Traveler was a fine establishment with large, well-furnished rooms, a play area for children, and a library that guests could peruse.

subLocations.name: Inn of the Dripping Dagger
subLocations.lore: The Inn of the Dripping Dagger was the favored bar and home to many adventurers, mercenaries, misfits and soldiers.

subLocations.name: Mother Tathlorn's House of Pleasure and Healing
subLocations.lore: Mother Tathlorn's House of Pleasure and Healing was a festhall and spa.
grounding: https://forgottenrealms.fandom.com/wiki/Mother Tathlorn's House of Pleasure and Healing

subLocations.name: Elfstone Tavern
subLocations.lore: The Elfstone Tavern was a tavern. It catered to elves and half-elves in the city.

subLocations.name: Golden Horn Gambling House
subLocations.lore: The Golden Horn Gambling House, which was also simply called the Golden Horn, was a [[festhall]].

subLocations.name: Unicorn's Horn
subLocations.lore: The Unicorn's Horn was an [[inn]].

subLocations.name: Gondalim's
subLocations.lore: Gondalim's was an [[inn]].

subLocations.name: Gentle Rest
subLocations.lore: The Gentle Rest was an [[inn]].

subLocations.name: The Gentle Mermaid
subLocations.lore: The Gentle Mermaid was a tavern, festhall, and gambling hall. The Gentle Mermaid had the largest gambling room throughout Waterdeep, and perhaps even throughout [[Faerûn]].

subLocations.name: The Raging Lion
subLocations.lore: The Raging Lion was owned by a man named [[Lhaerhlin Masram]]. Several [[dwarves]] and female [[adventurer]]s used the inn as their home. They helped Lhaerhlin maintain order during their stays between outings.

subLocations.name: A Maiden's Tears
subLocations.lore: A Maiden's Tears, which was also simply called the Tears, was a tavern. The tavern was quiet compared to others located in this part of the North Ward and patrons appreciated its private booths.

subLocations.name: The Misty Beard
subLocations.lore: Part of what made the Misty Beard famous up and down the [[Sword Coast]] was the staff which was composed of exotic or monstrous creatures from all over [[Faerûn]].

subLocations.name: Galloping Minotaur
subLocations.lore: Galloping Minotaur was an [[inn]] that was widely known and frequented by merchants and travelers.

subLocations.name: The Sailors' Own
subLocations.lore: The Sailors' Own was a rather shabby tavern near the docks.

subLocations.name: Crawling Spider
subLocations.lore: The Crawling Spider was a [[tavern]]. The tavern had a mock underground decor made from plaster and rock rubble. Stuffed spiders hung from the ceiling, giving the tavern its namesake.

subLocations.name: Sated Satyr
subLocations.lore: The Sated Satyr was a two-story, irregularly shaped building that fronted the streets or the alley on all sides but one.

subLocations.name: Wyvern's Rest
subLocations.lore: The Wyvern's Rest was an inn. Originally constructed as a stone watch house, the Wyvern's Rest was a favorite of guards and watchmen.

subLocations.name: Golden Harp Inn
subLocations.lore: The Golden Harp Inn was an [[inn]].

subLocations.name: High Flagon
subLocations.lore: The High Flagon was a gambling hall and inn.

subLocations.name: Twilight Hunters
subLocations.lore: Twilight Hunters was a tavern.

subLocations.name: Sapphire House
subLocations.lore: Sapphire House was an expensive rooming house.

subLocations.name: Tavern of the Flagon Dragon
subLocations.lore: The Tavern of the Flagon Dragon was a tavern.

subLocations.name: Jhrual's Dance
subLocations.lore: Jhrual's Dance was a [[festhall]].

subLocations.name: Smiling Siren
subLocations.lore: The Smiling Siren was a bawdy tavern/nightclub and theater that later became a [[festhall]] run by the church of [[Sune]].

subLocations.name: Mighty Manticore
subLocations.lore: This tavern was known for its thick and flavorful stew, sharp [[cheese]], fresh black bread, and hearty ale.

subLocations.name: The Asp's Strike
subLocations.lore: The Asp's Strike was a [[tavern]].

subLocations.name: Grinning Lion
subLocations.lore: The Grinning Lion was a [[tavern]].

subLocations.name: Greenglade Tower
subLocations.lore: Greenglade Tower was a popular and rather clean rooming house.

subLocations.name: Maelstrom's Notch
subLocations.lore: The Maelstrom's Notch was an [[inn]].

subLocations.name: Pickled Fisherman
subLocations.lore: The Pickled Fisherman was a tavern.

subLocations.name: Soaring Pegasus
subLocations.lore: The Soaring Pegasus was a tavern.

subLocations.name: Angry Coxswain
subLocations.lore: A [[magical]] ''[[Angry Coxswain Portal|portal]]'' existed within the tavern that Ramas and Orth used to ferry slaves to [[Mulhorand]]. The portal connected directly to a prison cell located in a market in [[Skuld]].

subLocations.name: Singed Bolt
subLocations.lore: The Singed Bolt was a tavern.

subLocations.name: Blackstone House
subLocations.lore: Mercenaries could be hired at Blackstone House.

subLocations.name: Blushing Nymph
subLocations.lore: The Blushing Nymph, or just the Nymph, was a festhall.

subLocations.name: Underdark
subLocations.lore: The Underdark tavern had a secret passage that led to [[Undermountain]] in the back of the establishment's basement.

subLocations.name: The Splintered Stair
subLocations.lore: A large spiraling staircase overlooked by balconies dominated the entry of the inn. The stairway was badly damaged during an epic brawl between adventurers, giving the inn its name. The rooms for rent were large, but also dark and cold.

subLocations.name: The Spouting Fish
subLocations.lore: The Spouting Fish was a popular tavern.

subLocations.name: Madame Garah's Boarding House
subLocations.lore: Madame Garah's Boarding House was a row house used as a boarding house.

subLocations.name: Soaring Delights
subLocations.lore: Soaring Delights was a [[:category:restaurants|restaurant]] built on the first floor of the hollow [[Hawk Man]].

subLocations.name: Skewered Dragon
subLocations.lore: The Skewered Dragon was a tavern. The clientele was primarily made up of dock workers that were suspicious of strangers.
